projects.summary: EvalAI is an AI-powered web application that evaluates handwritten answer sheets using Tesseract OCR and Gemini AI, generating marks, feedback, and performance reports automatically.

projects.title: Signova - Smart Sign Language Assistant Mobile App
projects.summary: An intelligent assistive mobile application developed for people who do not know sign language, enabling seamless two-way communication with the deaf and hard-of-hearing community.
projects.description: Signova is an innovative mobile application specially built for individuals who do not know sign language. It breaks communication barriers by translating spoken language and everyday text into clear visual sign language animations, and recognizing sign language hand gestures in real time using AI-powered camera vision. Featuring interactive sign tutorials, quick-phrase dictionaries, and an intuitive offline-first interface, Signova bridges the gap between sign language users and non-signers in schools, workplaces, healthcare centers, and everyday life.

projects.title: Inventory, Sales & Accounting Management System
projects.summary: Developed a web-based application to manage inventory, product stock, sales transactions, and accounting operations efficiently. Implemented features to streamline business workflows, maintain organized records, and simplify sales and inventory tracking.
projects.description: Developed a web-based application to manage inventory, product stock, sales transactions, and accounting operations efficiently. Implemented features to streamline business workflows, maintain organized records, and simplify sales and inventory tracking with real-time stock alerts, automated invoice generation, point-of-sale (POS) billing, supplier/customer ledgers, and comprehensive profit & loss analytics.

projects.title: GovExam Test Portal - Online Examination & Mock Test Platform
projects.summary: An interactive online exam test website for government exam preparation aspirants to easily attend timed tests and view their score instantly like a real exam.
projects.description: Designed and developed an end-to-end online examination platform tailored for government competitive exam preparation aspirants. The system delivers an authentic computer-based testing (CBT) environment with countdown timers, question palettes, section switching, and negative marking rules. Aspirants can easily attend mock tests and instantly view their comprehensive scorecard, percentile rank, time-per-question analysis, and detailed question-by-question explanations immediately upon submission.
